overview.description: The MicroSectors Solactive FANG & Innovation 3X Leveraged ETN (BULZ) is an exchange-traded product that is based on the Solactive FANG Innovation index. The fund aims to proivde 3x the daily price movements of an equal-weighted index of US-listed technology companies. BULZ was launched on Aug 20, 2021 and is issued by REX Microsectors.
